subject: [PATCH 18/22] mm/compaction: restrict compaction to common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch restricts the compaction process in Linux to common memory only, which is a subset of all available memory. The changes include modifying the kcompactd daemon to start on common nodes at boot and hotplug, limiting direct compaction to common zones, and restricting proactive compaction to common nodes. This approach aims to improve system performance by focusing compaction efforts on areas where it will have the most impact.
